title: Security Supervisor
location: King Abdullah Economic City, Saudi Arabia
description:
Company Description
Established in 2000 in Turkey, Rixos pioneers the 'ALL Inclusive, ALL Exclusive' concept, inviting guests to discover a world of possibilities with luxurious stays, culinary experiences, live entertainment, sports and fitness activities, spa and wellness journeys, and kids and teens activities.

Job Description
Keep the Assistant Security Manager / Director of Security informed of all security-related matters. Liaise with management personnel, employees, local law enforcement, and fire and safety officials. Train security employees on resort regulations, fire prevention, basic firefighting, life-saving techniques, evidence preservation, crisis actions, report writing, public relations, and psychology. Supervise daily security report distribution, confidentiality of records, emergency preparedness, preventive maintenance of safety equipment, staff access control, contractor and visitor movement, and frequent control of security posts including the CCTV room. Ensure all staff are familiar with emergency procedures and conduct regular technical and live fire-drill training.

Qualifications
University degree in any field. Minimum 2 years in a similar role with a five-star hotel. Team management skills, computer skills, and excellent communication skills.
